title: Bass player Branson Knolling and care of clarinet reeds
summary: After a brief closing, they return to a New Orleans bassist and Chace describes preparing reeds and his youthful obsession with a spitty tone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear
